name: Zyphra Hierarchical Attention compresses the KV-cache into a searchable tree
title: Zyphra Hierarchical Attention compresses the KV-cache into a searchable tree
summary: Zyphra's ZHA paper organizes the KV-cache as a tree of compressed summaries so queries only attend to a small fraction of tokens. With about 1B tokens of distillation it keeps most full-attention quality up to 35B parameters, scoring 93.3% vs 96% on RULER at 256K while attending to about 1 to 6% of the cache.
